note: STAND-IN. This file does not come from an entelos release.
Entelos has no release with the signed activation record yet (mohanraj00/entelos#105 and mohanraj00/entelos#155).

Each record has the field list of mohanraj00/entelos#105: the candidate, the base snapshot, the input lock, the approval and report receipts, the approver, the producer, the runner, the partition, the half-open effective interval and the request key.
A record has no signature, and the names and the layout of the fields are an assumption of this project.

To replace it: pin the entelos release in the seam requirements, make these records with that release, and change only the function `descriptor_of` in tests/test_activation_seam.py to read the released layout. Then set `stand_in` to false or remove this file.
All values are synthetic and neutral.
names: A value that starts with `$` is a name. The test binds it to a reference or a candidate identity of its own store, because these values depend on the content of the store.
